# omada_wlan_group (Data Source)

Looks up an Omada WLAN group by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omada_wlan_group" "default" {
  name = "Default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) WLAN group ID lookup selector and result.
- `name` (String) WLAN group name lookup selector and result.
- `site_id` (String) Site ID. Defaults to the provider site.

### Read-Only

- `primary` (Boolean) Whether this is the primary WLAN group.
